_method: A D1 team key that does not fold to its own display name is a SUBSTITUTION. It is SUSPECT only when that key also appears in another probed sport's vendor key set; otherwise it is an unremarkable within-sport alias. also_in names which other sports. Only sports probed together can be compared, so also_in [] means unclassified, never benign-by-default.
